findings.rationale: The prior review's sw-exec-r-3 DECIDE flagged 11 constructor-direct-insert tools as missing from the byte-ceiling census (REGISTRY_ONLY_DESCRIPTIONS + BUILTIN_TOOL_DEFINITIONS). Re-verified on current code: 9 of 11 are now in REGISTRY_ONLY_DESCRIPTIONS (acp_session_control, channel_message, channel_directory, channel_outbox, local_voice, voice_mode_set, audio_generate, video_generate, speech_generate). 2 remain: team_task_control and task_exit_journal. Both are dispatched (tool_registry_impl.rs:992, :1000), both ship description bytes per request, neither is measured by the byte ratchet (definitions.rs CATALOG_DESCRIPTION_CEILING_BYTES sums BUILTIN_TOOL_DEFINITIONS + REGISTRY_ONLY_DESCRIPTIONS + INJECTED + BRIDGE) nor by thinker/prompt_contract::no_sentence_is_stated_twice. The every_registered_core_tool_is_accounted test passes only because the test scans core_tools.rs + optional_tools.rs (reg() sites) + REG_INSERTED_NAMES — it does NOT scan coord_team_tools.rs.
findings.proposed_change: Option A (recommended, three-line patch, mirrors the existing acp_session_control row): add ("team_task_control", crate::builtin_tools::team::TeamTaskControlTool::DESCRIPTION) and ("task_exit_journal", crate::builtin_tools::team::TaskExitJournalTool::DESCRIPTION) to REGISTRY_ONLY_DESCRIPTIONS at definitions.rs:1299. Option B: move the entries into BUILTIN_TOOL_DEFINITIONS (larger diff, inflates unconditional catalogue). Option C (separate from the row fix): extend every_registered_core_tool_is_accounted to include_str! coord_team_tools.rs and enumerate its tools.insert sites — fifth registration shape, per the prior review's DECIDE rationale.
findings.risk: None at runtime (the tools work and are advertised today). The patch's only effect is to bring the byte ceiling and the duplicate-sentence scanner back in line with shipped text. Future risk if left unfixed: a guard that certifies N-of-(N+1) shapes hands a clean bill of health to the half still unmeasured, letting prompt bytes grow unnoticed — same shape as the prior review's documented risk.
findings.verification: rg 'task_exit_journal|team_task_control' src/executor/builtin_registry/definitions.rs after patch → 2 matches in REGISTRY_ONLY_DESCRIPTIONS. rg 'REG_INSERTED_NAMES' definitions.rs after a hypothetical Option C → unchanged (the row table is correct; the test scanner is the gap). cargo test -p alephcore --lib every_registered_core_tool_is_accounted → currently green (the test only validates its own scope); after Option C the test would FAIL on a future omission.
